Способы работают одновременно. Бан, филь: The methods work at the same time. Bans, filters and the queue limit apply everywhere. The streamer, moderators and names on the “Always allowed” list skip the access level and cooldowns. The service learns a viewer's status from their chat badges: someone who hasn't written in chat while the service is running counts as a regular viewer.
Награду создаёт сервис: только у награды: The service creates the reward itself: only a reward created with your own Client ID can have redemptions marked as played and points refunded. The viewer must enter text. If the message couldn't be read aloud, the points are refunded. Turning this method off pauses the reward.
Команды (<code>!…</code>) и эмоуты не оз: Commands (!…) and emotes are not read aloud. A message sent together with the reward is read once, as the reward.
